notes.title: New Free Otome / Girls Love Visual Novel!
notes.content:
Our newest free visual novel is here! March is the time for NaNoRenO, the annual visual novel game jam, and this year we went even bigger. Last year we created Alice in Stardom, a free girls love visual novel with 3 routes, with a great but small team. This year we wanted to make an otome / girls love visual novel with longer routes, more art, more polish- more, more, more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108631/44c65a12fdada90d428f0a2f4e024d52b82c3985.png[/img]

With the help of Paths Taken and Alice in Stardom's lead artist, Violora, we were able to direct a team of 10+ artists in March-April to create Enamored Risks. This game is fully free and was created in just a month and a half, but it's one of our best yet.

The game is about Alex, a lonely college student who just wants a break from it all, when one day she stumbles upon a mysterious social media account. She ends up meeting a group of urban explorers and starts going on mini-adventures with them- and possibly falling in love with one.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274200/Enamored_Risks/

Try it out if you want a free otome / girls love VN to play! It has 3 routes and over 50,000 words~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108631/7a7cf17b22645d0b65b3ec91112fe72ff4ffb689.png[/img]

notes.title: New Dating Sim Visual Novel - Memories on the Shoreline
notes.content:
Hey guys, just a quick heads up that our newest otome dating sim visual novel, Memories on the Shoreline, has just released! If you enjoy dating sims (which I'm sure most of your do), then check this one out- you can date a merman in it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35108631/87c42629df9f41116d9d817739d00d2583bfe34d.jpg[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145460/Memories_on_the_Shoreline/][h1]Steam Page for Memories on the Shoreline[/h1][/url]

Memories on the Shoreline is an otome dating sim featuring Melody, a med student, on her vacation of a lifetime where she meets two bachelors while at the beach. Brennan, the cheeky lady's man who's a bit overprotective, and Crylis, the fugitive merman who's hides behind a lot of snark. How exactly is she going to get herself out of this trouble—?!

It's been quite a few months since we came up with the idea for this and started drafting it and we're happy to finally release another visual novel to you guys. We hope you enjoy!

[h1][url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]Join our Discord Server[/url]​ ❤️ [url=https://twitter.com/CrystalGameWork]Follow us on Twitter[/url][/h1]

notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
Paths Taken is now fully released! The full game is 30,000+ words with 4 routes, each with achievements. This game has been in development for over 4 years due to a lot of bumps, but we hope you guys enjoy the full game!

[b]If you want to get updates on our games in progress, [url=https://twitter.com/CrystalGameWork]follow us on Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]join our Discord[/url]![/b] If you like Paths Taken and want more free yuri games, try our previous title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1054560/Alice_in_Stardom__A_Free_Idol_Visual_Novel/]Alice in Stardom[/url]!
